newsitem.title: FRANCE: G. des Eaux backs S.Gobain on Suez div.
newsitem.headline: G. des Eaux backs S.Gobain on Suez div.

text.p: Generale des Eaux said on Thursday it supported a call by Saint-Gobain for an exceptional dividend payment from Cie de Suez ahead of its merger with Lyonnaise des Eaux.
Saint-Gobain head Louis Beffa earlier this week called on Suez to pay an amount equivalent to 3.4 billion francs to existing shareholders ahead of its planned merger.
"The figure mentioned by Mr Beffa seems to me a reasonable amount," Generale des Eaux head Jean-Marie Messier told a news conference to present its 1996 results.
He said Beffa's call for a dividend was supported by Belgian businessman Albert Frere, a major player in the merger talks, and Claude Bebear, head of insurer Axa-UAP.
"We have found common ground with Beffa as well as with Albert Frere and Claude Bebear," Messier said.
He said the special dividend would reflect the loyalty of Suez shareholders and allow them to enjoy the benefits of restructuring carried out in recent years.
